text:
Maya: Quick micro-game — I'll buy lunch for the first person who solves this one-liner riddle. Reply with your guess + your lunch order. Riddle: `I move without legs, I speak without lips, I can be broken but never fall.` 10-minute window. Go!
Jamal: Hmm... 'record'? one-liner: 'I cracked a record once, I'll bring the egg salad.' 😂
Priya: My guess is 'silence'. Also I vote turkey + avocado.
Lila: Echo? I'll take a roasted veggie wrap.
Ben: My money's on 'sound'. BLT for me if I win.
Noor: Sound sounds right. Avocado toast pls.
Sam: One-liner: 'I'm not falling for this, but I will fall for a good sandwich.' Tuna melt for me.
Alex: Also putting in a formal objection: my brain wants 'echo' but my ears want 'sound'.
Maya: Nice. Clues: 'can be broken' = think physics term.
Priya: Ah, that makes sense. silence was a bad read.
Lila: Oooh physics clue -> yeah sound fits.
Ben: Celebrate early? :tada: Also I put in my BLT preference again.
LunchBot: Congratulations Ben — correct answer: "sound". Lunch bounty logged. Ben: BLT (no pickles) — Maya owes you one. :sandwich:
Alex: Wow that was fast. Nice one-liner attempts everyone.
Noor: Second place should at least get sympathy fries.
Sam: I'll accept a sympathy cookie.
Maya: Will DM Ben for delivery logistics. Thanks for playing y'all. Made my afternoon. :smile:
